stages.name: released-plugin contract
stages.doc: the plugin contract tests that use OxiGuitar's released plugins (`cargo test -p oxiguitar-plugin-test --features released`)

stages.name: plugin template
stages.doc: a plugin built from the template as the plugin guide says, and checked (`scripts/check-plugin-template.sh`)

ready.why: needs the Rust the template names in rust-version (its nested builds can't take --ignore-rust-version)

stages.name: no network
stages.doc: on Linux, a whole session of the app and the command-line program under strace, failing at any attempt to open an internet connection (`scripts/test-no-network.sh`; needs strace, weston and Xvfb)

stages.name: speed budget
stages.doc: the speed budgets (`cargo test --release -p oxiguitar-app speed`): advisory, since they depend on the machine
